title: Concept: Package manifest with no tools version
description: Package.swift declares a manifest that declares no Swift tools version, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a manifest that declares no Swift tools version.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Package.swift (swift).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a manifest that declares no Swift tools version.
